subject: physics
content:
The driver of a bus approaching a big wall notices that the frequency of his bus's horn changes
from 420 Hz to 490 Hz when he hears it after it gets reflected from the wall. Find the speed of the
bus if speed of the sound is 330 ms<sup>–1</sup>.
